datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly basis throughout 2019 for Yemen. Geographic boundaries were classified into IPC phases (1-5) representing acute food insecurity severity levels, with spatial data provided in GeoJSON and KML formats for February through October 2019.

sources.description: IPC (Integrated Food Security Phase Classification) spatial data collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular monthly schedule to classify acute food insecurity severity across geographic areas.
